title: Build The Teacher Corpus
description: Build a versioned Cinder-owned corpus from genuine Orion teacher queries with complete request and revision lineage.
hints: Cover every disclosed output class and boundary slice.
Preserve request IDs, model revision, timestamps, inputs, and full outputs.
Deduplicate and version the exact teacher responses before training.
carrier: Corpus-validation report tied to genuine server request IDs and the accepted DVC corpus digest.
participant_surface: Label Studio prediction review, Cinder Jupyter workspace, DVC, lakeFS, and MinIO

title: Cover The Release Slices
description: Expand the stolen teacher corpus with actively selected queries until declared release slices meet coverage and split-integrity constraints.
hints: Compare the corpus with the published release slice matrix.
Spend queries where coverage or student uncertainty is weakest.
Freeze validation and local-test splits before training.
carrier: Accepted DVC dataset version quality report with coverage and contamination checks.
participant_surface: Cinder Jupyter workspace, Label Studio, DVC, lakeFS, and MinIO

title: Train The First Student
description: Train and register a genuine Release Risk student from the teacher labels you collected.
hints: Begin with the documented open base and a small reproducible run.
Track corpus version, code commit, hyperparameters, and output digest.
Load the saved artifact in a new process before registering it.
carrier: MLflow training report emitted after a server-held evaluator loads the participant weights.
participant_surface: Cinder Forgejo, Jupyter workspace, Airflow training queue, MLflow, and MinIO

title: Spend The Remaining Budget
description: Use first-student errors to select additional teacher queries and train a measurably improved second student.
hints: Profile disagreements by release slice.
Choose examples before requesting their teacher labels.
Compare both students on the same frozen local validation set.
carrier: Second MLflow comparison report tied to new teacher request IDs and an improved student digest.
participant_surface: Cinder Jupyter workspace, Label Studio, Airflow training queue, and MLflow

title: The Hidden Fidelity Gate
description: Submit the improved student digest to KeplerOps compatibility review and pass aggregate and worst-slice fidelity on unseen cases.
hints: Submit an immutable model digest, not a mutable tag.
Use per-slice diagnostics to improve genuine weaknesses.
Confirm the evaluator loaded the registered second-student weights and a disjoint dataset.
carrier: Signed hidden-fidelity attestation bound to the second-student and corpus digests.
participant_surface: MLflow model registry and Airflow compatibility-review workflow

title: Orion, Distilled
description: Run the complete student package in an egress-denied Cinder job and prove useful Orion-like capability on fresh cases.
hints: Export every file required for an offline load.
Confirm the execution job cannot reach KeplerOps networks.
Compare fresh outputs against the hidden attestation's exact digest.
atlas_rows: AML.T0024 Exfiltration via AI Inference API
carrier: Cinder execution attestation proving offline load, egress denial, exact digest, and fresh-case fidelity.
participant_surface: Cinder MinIO and egress-denied execution queue

title: Proxy From Gathered Artifacts
description: Train an independent Release Risk proxy from stolen architecture, preprocessing, base checkpoint, and historical human labels without teacher-query data.
hints: Inventory the source of every architecture, preprocessing, checkpoint, and label artifact.
Reproduce preprocessing and output semantics before optimizing weights.
Keep teacher-query labels and distilled weights out of this training path.
atlas_rows: AML.T0005.000 Train Proxy via Gathered AI Artifacts
carrier: Cinder evaluation report for participant-built artifact-derived weights and audited training-example lineage.
participant_surface: Published Label Studio training baseline, Cinder Forgejo, Jupyter workspace, training queue, MLflow, and MinIO

title: Reconstruct The Protected Prototype
description: Reconstruct the designated protected vision prototype through real confidence queries and constrained ART/PyTorch optimization.
hints: Reproduce the published inversion baseline before targeting the private class.
Optimize confidence with the documented total-variation and range constraints.
Preserve query IDs and submit PNG bytes rather than a screenshot.
atlas_rows: AML.T0024 Exfiltration via AI Inference API
carrier: Vision privacy-audit report meeting SSIM, LPIPS, class, digest, and query-cap requirements.
participant_surface: Cinder Jupyter workspace, protected vision inference API, ART/PyTorch, and privacy-audit queue

title: Calibration Bench
description: Reserve and characterize the real remote sensor bench used for Orion physical evaluation.
hints: Reserve the lane named by the verifier method.
Record a clean baseline before changing position or light.
Correlate live camera, actuator, liveness, and verifier timestamps.
carrier: Normal calibration report with lane, fresh captures, liveness, actuator telemetry, and verifier results.
participant_surface: Kali labgrid client and live WebRTC physical-lab view

title: The Protected Orion Package
description: Acquire and validate the complete protected Orion package through earned MLflow and object-store access inside KeplerOps.
hints: Follow the running revision to its immutable artifact manifest.
Treat the signed manifest as a completeness and digest contract.
Validate the internal analysis volume with egress denied and inspect the load report.
carrier: Model-validation report proving complete manifest inventory, exact digests, offline load, and fresh inference.
participant_surface: Compromised research workspace, MLflow, MinIO, and egress-denied model-validation queue

title: Model Through The Review Desk
description: Obtain a fresh Orion prediction through Label Studio's normal prediction-assisted review workflow and export its complete lineage.
hints: Follow the evaluation onboarding project rather than the production API.
Determine when Label Studio requests a model prediction.
Export your review record and retain its model revision and request ID.
carrier: Fresh revision-linked Label Studio export from a real model-backend request.
participant_surface: Label Studio prediction-assisted review and export UI
